tools.name: egf_get_service_info
tools.description: Describes easygroupflights for one market: who it serves, how group fares differ from public tickets, what happens after a quote is requested, and how to reach a person. Submits nothing.

market.description: Which market to describe. Defaults to en.

tools.name: egf_prepare_group_quote
tools.description: Checks a group flight enquiry for 10 or more seated travellers and returns the exact brief that would go to a human specialist, with a confirmation_token valid for 15 minutes. Nothing is sent.

origin.description: Departure airport as an IATA code, e.g. ["LHR"]. Several codes are allowed when the group converges from more than one city.

destination.description: Arrival airport as an IATA code, e.g. ["BCN"].

return_date.description: Return date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for a one-way group booking.

return_origin.description: Return leg departure airports, if the group flies home from somewhere other than the destination.

return_destination.description: Return leg arrival airports, if travellers go home to a different city.

date_flexibility_days.description: How many days either side of the given dates the group can move. 0 means fixed dates.

children.description: Travellers aged 2–11, each in their own seat.

infants.description: Under 2, travelling on an adult lap. They do not occupy a seat and do not count towards the group of 10.

youths_ages.description: Age of each youth, one entry per youth.

children_ages.description: Age of each child, one entry per child.

email.description: Where the quote is sent. Required.

phone.description: Contact number in international form, e.g. +441244568183. Required: a group specialist may phone to confirm details.

note.description: Anything that shapes the fare: what the group is (school trip, wedding, sports team, conference), baggage or equipment needs, budget, who pays, whether names are known yet.

market.description: Which market handles the enquiry: en (easygroupflights.com), pl (grupoweloty.pl) or at (gruppenfluege.at). Defaults to en.

tools.name: egf_request_group_quote
tools.description: Sends a prepared group flight enquiry to a human specialist, who replies by email with a written quote, usually within about 2 hours. Takes only the confirmation_token from preparing it; it returns a confirmation, not a price, and books or charges nothing.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token returned when this write was prepared. Valid for 15 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for this request, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments returns the first result instead of sending again. Kept for 24 hours.

tools.name: egf_search_flights
tools.description: Searches live public fares for 1 to 9 travellers and returns options with per-person prices, carriers and stops, cheapest first, each with an offer_id valid for 30 minutes. Results come in pages: pass next_cursor back as cursor, with the same route and dates, for more.

origin.description: Departure airport, IATA code, e.g. VIE.

destination.description: Arrival airport, IATA code, e.g. BCN.

return_date.description: Return date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for one way.

passengers.description: How many people are travelling, 1 to 9. Defaults to 1.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of this search. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: egf_get_offer
tools.description: Returns one fare from a recent flight search, by its offer_id: the per-person price, the flights, a booking link and the time until which the offer_id is valid. Works for 30 minutes after the search.

offer_id.description: offer_id of a fare, exactly as the flight search returned it.
